sampling: Exact seeded stochastic policy; identical independent role uniform tapes per map across conditions.
scope: Explicit fixed-opponent development evaluation. No training-return selection; maps reused for ranking are not held-out evidence.

encoderPreparation.description: Explicit weights-only migration: bounded grounded jump added with new action head; taller walls; exclusive unlocked grabs; locking releases the carrier; tool entropy reduced tenfold. Actor tensors retained; fresh optimizer state.

candidate.criticInitialization: Same inherited residual critic weights in both arms; new AdamW state. No claim of calibration to the projected actor.
candidate.optimizerInitialization: Both actor Adam states and central critic AdamW state start empty in both arms.
candidate.actorInput: Restricted 210 observations; all ten object slots and thirty range sensors; no opponent identity or central state
candidate.rule: Only original zero-sum visibility reward; physical grab/lock semantics; no distance-only hiding
candidate.comparisons: New environment and sensor contract. Inherited weights, fresh optimizers. Current versus fixed migrated reference and counterfactual tools-disabled evaluations; not an isolated architecture ablation.
